items.quote:
Daddy, I just want to take a moment to appreciate and honor you. You have been a father, a mentor and a source of encouragement. Your prayers, guidance and sacrifices, and the way you pour into people's lives mean more than words can express.

May God continue to strengthen you, increase you and everything you put your hands to. We're truly grateful to have you as our Pastor, Prophet and Father.
items.name: Kebs

items.quote: Chief is such an amazing Man of God! He has helped guide me through the toughest times. I thank you Chief and I don't take it lightly. May God continue to increase you.
items.name: Niki, FL
